## Public-repo safety

- [ ] No credentials, `.env`, local paths, private MCP config, or personal data added
- [ ] New third-party assets/code include provenance and redistribution rights
- [ ] Large editable media follows Git LFS rules
- [ ] Generated debug/WIP outputs are not committed unless they are curated acceptance evidence
